Dalton Cooper is the Managing Editor of GameRant. Dalton has been writing about video games professionally since 2011 and joined the GameRant team in 2015. Having written thousands of game reviews and articles over the course of his career, Dalton is one of the most prolific gaming journalists in the industry. Dalton covers the latest breaking news for GameRant, as well as writes reviews, guide content, and more.

Earned all the achievements in Dark Souls, Dark Souls 2, and Elden Ring.
Dalton's articles cover every facet of the gaming industry, but with a particular focus on console gaming specifically. Dalton writes news stories on a huge variety of gaming topics, hunts down free games for GameRant's readers, and dedicates countless hours to reviewing the biggest new game releases.
